sequence.purpose: Clear runway; show the first lesson before commitment.
Climb onto the first reef shelf.
Lift the front wheel over one readable reef edge.
Recover wheel contact before the scoop.
Use a curved lip to cross a shallow channel.
Collect the bike in a broad basin.
Dip then spring onto the high coral shelf.
Ride the sagging connection between shelves.
Settle wheel contact and rebuild controlled entry speed between the added challenges.
Cross another shallow channel onto a broad reef catch.
Ride a second arched reef connection.
Settle wheel contact and rebuild controlled entry speed between the added challenges.
Cross the last rounded coral bank.
Return to shore in two visible terraces.
Finish release after the last challenge.
